plan_contract: B-SPEC section 5: within-sample average ranks, no stable-gene reference, known direction, centered TotalScore
technical_role: Deterministic descriptive gene-signature scoring; not a hypothesis test, causal estimator, cell-count estimate or specificity certification

input_contract.meaning: First column literal unique gene IDs; other columns literal unique sample IDs; finite numeric expression; no missing-value filling, normalization, mapping, selection or row dropping
Unique already-mapped gene IDs plus explicit up/down direction; nonempty up arm required; no duplicate, overlapping or missing members
Exactly one metadata row per matrix sample, literal sample and nonempty group; groups attached after scoring, never used for ranking

output_contract.meaning: sample, TotalScore, group; exact matrix sample order, finite scores; no automatic biological interpretation
Full official rank_data and simple score/dispersion table plus joined scores; RDS contents are not extra declared ports
Method/version and execution diagnostics; input/scoring failures retain logs, not normal scores/RDS

supported_scope: Dense finite numeric matrix TSV; up-only or bidirectional signature vectors; rankGenes(tiesMethod=average, stableGenes=NULL), simpleScore(centerScore=TRUE, knownDirection=TRUE, dispersionFun=stats::mad)
unsupported_scope: Missing expression or missing signature members
UCell, z-mean, pseudobulk or source70 substitution

evidence.reference_environment: Fresh official source installed in a separate library and separate OCI processes; dependency/OS environment shared, not host execution

official_package_example.scope: Published author-package example, not study cohort data

evidence.graph_scope: Three original native file_reference inputs plus original dynamically compiled singscore_bspec, four nodes/three edges when connected; failure controls include missing edge and unknown spec parameter
evidence.rank_matrix_comparison: Exact complete matrix with IDs, axes and attributes
evidence.simple_score_comparison: Final independent verification requires identical complete RDS score/dispersion tables and attributes; TSV values each use absolute tolerance 1e-12, never a mean/relative or NaN agreement
evidence.input_identity_boundary: Final jobs use supported cached path/format input specs; external fixture SHA256 checked independently. Cached primitive lacks current hash_content API; no input caching/hash qualification is granted

manifest_resources.scope: Per-container declaration; not global host/resource-budget certification

remaining: Freeze approved software/method version and qualified inputs in the active design; this code does not amend those files
Per-signature original/mapped/measurable/missing member ledger, 80%/5 thresholds and per-direction coverage
Frozen common background, RNA-seq length processing or array probe consolidation, eligible cohorts/donors/contrasts
Full B-SPEC score-to-Welch/paired-test/family chain, missing P propagation and family denominator preservation
Actual deployed registry/binary/source/image identity and resident execution
All package branches, large-scale memory/performance, arbitrary encodings/filesystems, transactional multi-file publication and crash recovery
Cache reuse/invalidation, mutable-local immutability semantics and global cross-daemon resource budgets
Independent reviewer approval; no developer self-issued scientific release
spatial_boundary: B-S CONDITIONAL_NOT_READY; GS01 OPEN; no null model selected
